title: Deleting a term another user already deleted says it was not found
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-34 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open on the Active tab in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Delete Credit Term".
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  6. In your browser, click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the delete confirmation opens.
  • Step 3: {User-B}'s menu opens.
  • Step 4: {User-B}'s confirmation opens.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees the toast "{Term-A} deleted".
  • Step 6: the app's error alert shows "Credit term not found." and the confirmation stays open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • Story 2, Error Handling: “If a save is refused, the app's standard error alert shows the reason, using these exact texts: "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." (deactivating or deleting the default); "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (editing or deleting a term in use); "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated."; "Pick an active term other than Credit Hold." (making an inactive term or Credit Hold the default); "Credit term not found." (the term was deleted meanwhile). The delete confirmation stays open when the delete is refused.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Term no longer exists (server) | "Credit term not found." | Standard error alert”
